title: Re-Volt
shortDescription: Re-Volt helps define a Nintendo 64 racing path in GameAtlas through original editorial framing and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced racing option to the Nintendo 64 discovery path.
Pairs original GameAtlas organization with a direct Wikidata structured-data record.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog entry
signals.rationale: Recorded for the Nintendo 64 racing discovery path using Wikidata-listed platform and genre statements; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
